name: 3D model from a photo
tagline: Image to 3D model from a photo or illustration, for indie games and AI creators.
description: Image to 3D Model turns a photo or illustration into a 3D model in the browser. Sign in for 20 welcome credits (one Trellis model). Export GLB for editing or STL for slicing. A multi-view workspace accepts 2–8 photos of the same object. Built for game assets, prototypes, and concept art.
